why: All the figures are the same notched shape turned to different angles, except one that is a mirror image (flipped over). In option 2 the tall end of the shape is on the other side of the round notch, so it is flipped, not just turned. Turning a shape can never make its mirror image.
trick: Walk around the outline in one direction and list the sides (long, tall, notch, short). A mirrored shape gives the list in reverse order.
note: Book answer is 2. Careful check: option 5 also seems to be a mirror image like option 2 (its tall end is also on the other side of the notch); the scan drawing of 5 may be inaccurate. SVGs drawn as exact rotations/mirrors of one shape.
